integrity.computation_scope: Independent direct-character checks for dimensions four through eight, formulas tested through forty-four; these do not replace proof.
integrity.proof_scope: All integer dimensions at least four via exact character identities and eigenvalue comparisons.

scientific_limitations: Only ternary finite-field spheres, complete uniform sampling and the first Fourier coordinate band, dimensions at least four. Explicit exceptional singularity at dimension four and radius two. Higher bands and partial sampling not addressed.
title: A parity law for optimally conditioned first-band Fourier sampling on ternary spheres
